findings.claim: The send and reply --workspace help says the default is the parent of cwd, but the lib (mail.ts:2231) uses the parent of the repo root (the git toplevel), as the verify option's help and the MailSendOptions doc already say; from <repo>/packages/cli the help implies <repo>/packages while the lib uses the repo's parent.
The new send-mirror comment carries a bare issue ref '(the #2097 seam)' against the house rule that every ref is repo-qualified.
The mirror's header comment still names only the poll, reply and mark registrations; the mirror now covers send and verify too.

The no-flag case's toBeUndefined passes on the pre-fix code too (a default guard, not a fix test); the four positional cases carry the fix with exact toEqual; the mirror cannot detect drift from index.ts, which only the real-CLI probe covers. No change owed.

verdict: Leg 1 over 466be61c: 0 BLOCKING, 0 MATERIAL, 4 MINOR, nothing blocking. The real built CLI honours --workspace for send and reply in both positions (a throwaway fixture: the fixed dist verified routable with the flag before or after the subcommand; the 2.11.1 global printed the unknown-recipient warning in both positions); Commander's optsWithGlobals merges globals over locals and the subcommand scope never holds --workspace, so nothing is overwritten with undefined; mark and verify carry no latent copy of the bug; the reply's --no-mark translation and rest are unchanged. F1, F2, F3 folded at the next commit (the two help strings say 'the parent of the repo root'; the ref qualified; the mirror header names send and verify); F4 stands as read.
